svg.desc: OrderFlow worked example (dark theme). ViewBox 1660x880. Four layers — surfaces, API gateway, services, data — composed from md-card--outlined, md-card--service-primary/secure, md-card--service-{sql,store,cache,slate}, and inlined Material Symbols.
svg.text: Four layers from shopper surfaces through to persistence · multi-region · ~120k orders/day
